name: Hotel Mayura Riverview Restaurant (KSTDC)
area: Toll Gate, banks of the Cauvery, Srirangapatna
why_it_matters: The restaurant of the government-run KSTDC Hotel Mayura Riverview, set on the banks of the Cauvery at Srirangapatna — the most scenic sit-down dining in town. It has three dining areas: the Kuteera canopy overlooking the river, an open-air Garden restaurant with tables on the steps down to the water, and an indoor bar-restaurant. Multi-cuisine menu from Indian to Chinese.
insider_tip: Come for the riverside setting — the Garden restaurant on the steps to the Cauvery is the spot, best in the cool of the morning or evening. A natural lunch break on the Bengaluru-Mysuru route. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Riverview, Toll Gate, Srirangapatna, Mandya District, Karnataka 571438

name: Thotada Mane
signature_dish: Home-style Karnataka meals in an areca grove
why_it_matters: The highest-rated restaurant in Srirangapatna on Tripadvisor — a charming, peaceful place set behind an areca-nut grove that shelters it from the highway. Reviewers praise the simple, well-made home-style Karnataka food and the courteous owner; it is a short deviation off the Mysore highway and worth the detour.
insider_tip: It is a little off the main highway — follow the signs, the calm areca-grove setting is part of the appeal. Home-style Karnataka food rather than a big menu. Cash, UPI and cards.
signature_address: Thotada Mane, off the Bengaluru-Mysuru highway, Srirangapatna, Mandya District, Karnataka 571438

name: Poojari Fish Land
signature_dish: Bunt-style fish curry and fried fish
why_it_matters: A large seafood restaurant on the Bengaluru-Mysuru highway stretch near Srirangapatna — a long-standing favourite for fresh fish on the Bengaluru-Mysuru run. Silver fish, pomfret, seer fish, crab, prawn and squid cooked Bunt-style, with frying done in coconut oil, served with neer dosa, naan and rice.
insider_tip: Plenty of parking and a roadside-attraction feel with vintage cars at the entrance, but reviewers warn service can be slow and chaotic at peak times — go off-peak. The Bunt-style fish curry and crab masala are the orders. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Poojari Fish Land, Bengaluru-Mysuru Highway, near Srirangapatna, Mandya District, Karnataka 571438

name: Parampare Veg Restaurant
area: Bengaluru-Mysuru Road, near Check Post, Srirangapatna
signature_dish: Pure-veg South and North Indian meals
why_it_matters: A large pure-veg restaurant on the Bengaluru-Mysuru road near the Srirangapatna check post, opposite the KSTDC Mayura Riverview — a convenient highway veg stop for families travelling the route, with spacious seating and South and North Indian dishes.
insider_tip: Reviews are mixed on hygiene and service, so set expectations to a busy highway restaurant; go at off-peak hours and stick to the South Indian tiffin. Easy to combine with the riverside KSTDC across the road. Cards, UPI and cash.
signature_address: Parampare Veg Restaurant, SH-17 Bengaluru-Mysuru Road, near Check Post, Srirangapatna, Mandya District, Karnataka 571438

name: Hotel Rajakumara
why_it_matters: A town restaurant in Srirangapatna listed among the handful of eateries on Tripadvisor — a basic, budget South Indian meals-and-tiffin stop for visitors doing the temple, fort and Tipu Sultan circuit who want a quick local meal in town.
insider_tip: A simple, no-frills town option — fine for a quick dosa or meals between sightseeing stops. Reviews are mixed, so keep it to the South Indian tiffin. Cash and UPI.
signature_address: Hotel Rajakumara, Srirangapatna, Mandya District, Karnataka 571438
